en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a photograph of an ancient round Greek mirror with a relief of a woman's face with curly hair. The object is centered on a plain background. Beneath the image, printed in small capital letters, are the title and the institution: on the left, the label of the artifact and approximate date, and on the right, the name of the museum. The lower half of the postcard is blank for writing.
